title: Securitize Mints Stablecoins Directly With Anchorage Digital Bank
ai_summary: Securitize now mints and redeems stablecoins directly with Anchorage Digital Bank, which handles custody and settlement. The partnership gives Securitize, the world's largest tokenization platform by assets under management, direct minting and redemption. Anchorage said regulated issuance unlocks institutional scale for tokenization.

title: Securitize Will Mint Stablecoins Directly With Anchorage Digital Bank
ai_summary: Securitize, the tokenization platform behind funds from BlackRock, Apollo, and KKR, will source the dollars that settle those trades from a federally chartered bank instead of intermediaries. The company said it will use a bank to provide settlement funds for its tokenized trades.

title: Spark Liquidity Layer allocates over $3B across DeFi venues
ai_summary: Spark Liquidity Layer has deployed over $3 billion across DeFi venues, including SparkLend, Morpho, Uniswap, and Anchorage loans, as of October 16, 2026. Governance sets rate limits enforced by smart contracts, and the allocator holds about 25% of the on-chain capital allocator category. It generated roughly $12 million in fees over a 30-day period.
